title: Watchlist: a removed stock comes back after a reload
signature: watchlist | removal not persisted | removed ticker ≠ absent after reload

report.prerequisite: MarketFlow demo opened with ?defect=watchlist-remove-not-saved; empty watchlist
report.scope: Watchlist page only. Removing from the board star or the stock page is not affected.

steps.say: This video shows a bug in the MarketFlow demo. Removing a stock from the watchlist is not saved.
First, sign in with the QA test account.
On the market board, add ACB and FPT to the watchlist with the star buttons.
Open the watchlist. Both stocks are listed.
Now remove FPT with its star. The row disappears, and the count shows one stock.
Actual result: FPT is back on the watchlist. The removal was never saved.
Expected result: FPT stays removed after a reload, and the count stays at one stock.
